response_file_rule: data/<responding_unit>.csv for each responding unit listed in data/ORs.csv

raw_format.r_rownames_column: unnamed leading column present in data rows but omitted from header

mapping_policy: preserve responding-unit identity and separately attach all matching receptor/sensillum/OSN/glomerulus mapping rows from door_mappings.csv
geosmin_calibration_note: DoOR ab4B contains Stensmyr.2012.WT and other assay-specific geosmin values. Preserve them by assay. They are not a dose-response curve unless source metadata establish concentrations.
qualification_requirements: exact commit and clean checkout verified
Git blob identity of frozen index files verified
SHA-256 computed for every ingested response file
R row-name offset validated for every CSV
missing responses preserved as missingness rather than zero
normalized long-form artifact and receipt content-addressed
study-level concentration/assay metadata adjudicated before evidence qualification
